title: The Campus Library Orientation: A Step-by-Step Guide
instructions: 阅读下面的文章，回答10个问题。文章是关于大学图书馆新生导览的模拟材料。请仔细阅读，答案必须来自文章。
passage:
Welcome to the Campus Library Orientation. This guide is written for new students who want to use the library effectively. The library is a large building with four floors, and each floor has a different purpose. The orientation is designed to help you find your way and use the resources. Please read the steps below carefully.

A. Before You Visit

First, you should register for a library account online. The registration form is found on the library website. You need your student ID number and your email address to complete the form. After you submit the form, you will receive a confirmation email within 24 hours. Second, you must activate your account at the front desk on your first visit. The staff will check your student ID and give you a library card. Without a library card, you cannot borrow books or use the computers.

B. On Your First Visit

When you enter the library, go to the information desk on the ground floor. A staff member will give you a map of the library. The map shows the location of each section. Then, you should attend a short orientation tour, which lasts about 30 minutes. The tour is offered every hour from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. During the tour, you will learn how to search for books using the online catalogue. You will also learn how to borrow and return books using the self-service machines. These machines are located next to the main entrance.

C. Using the Library Resources

The library has a large collection of books, journals, and digital resources. Books can be borrowed for two weeks. If you need more time, you can renew them online once. Renewals are allowed only if no one else has reserved the book. Journals and magazines cannot be borrowed; they must be read in the library. Digital resources, such as e-books and online databases, are available 24 hours a day. You can access them from any computer with your library account.

D. Study Spaces

The library offers different study spaces. The first floor has group study rooms, which can be booked online. Each room has a whiteboard and a large screen. The second floor is a quiet study area, where talking is not allowed. The third floor has computer workstations, which are equipped with the latest software. The fourth floor is a silent reading room, where you can read and study without any noise. Please respect these rules to maintain a good environment for everyone.

E. Returning Books and Fines

Books must be returned by the due date. If you return a book late, you will be charged a fine. The fine is 50 cents per day for each late book. You can pay the fine at the front desk or online. If you lose a book, you must pay the full price of the book plus a processing fee. Remember to return books on time to avoid fines.

F. Getting Help

If you need help, you can ask a librarian at the information desk. Librarians are available from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekends. You can also use the online chat service, which is available 24/7. The chat service is staffed by librarians who can answer your questions quickly. Additionally, the library offers workshops on research skills and citation styles. These workshops are free for all students and are held every Wednesday afternoon.

We hope this guide helps you make the most of the library. Enjoy your studies!

grammar.title: 被动语态、顺序连接词、定语从句与分词短语
grammar.explanation: 被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者，结构为be+过去分词。顺序连接词如first, then, after that用于表示步骤顺序。定语从句用who, which, that等引导，修饰名词。分词短语用现在分词或过去分词作定语或状语。
grammar.example: Books can be borrowed for two weeks.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The library account ______ online.
questions.explanation: 被动语态结构为情态动词+be+过去分词，因此选can be registered。
questions.evidence: you should register for a library account online.

questions.prompt: Which word is a sequence connector?
questions.explanation: First是顺序连接词，表示第一步。
questions.evidence: First, you should register for a library account online.

questions.prompt: Identify the relative clause in: 'The tour, which lasts about 30 minutes, is offered every hour.'
questions.explanation: 定语从句which lasts about 30 minutes修饰The tour。
questions.evidence: The tour, which lasts about 30 minutes, is offered every hour.

answers: Located next to the main entrance

questions.evidence: These machines are located next to the main entrance.
